dialogue_history.content: What do you mean by "Competitive Gaming Performance"?

Competitive Gaming Performance refers to a calculated metric that combines several performance factors, including Input Responsiveness Score, Sensor Performance Index, Switch Performance Rating, and Audio Responsiveness Index. It is represented as a weighted sum of these factors, with specific weights assigned to each component.
What do you mean by "Sensor Performance"?

"Sensor Performance" refers to the Sensor Performance Index (SPI), which is calculated as (dpires / 1000.0) * (1 - mcresptime / 10.0) * 10, where dpires is the DPI resolution and mcresptime is the mouse response time from the deviceidentity table.
What do you mean by "Input Responsiveness Score"?
Sorry, this question is out of scope, so I can not answer your question.
What do you mean by "calculated adoption rate value"?

By "calculated adoption rate value," I mean the Professional Adoption Rating (PAR) which is derived from the formula: (CGPI / 10.0) * (1 + profcount / 5.0) * ((SPI + IRS) / 15.0). This value represents the adoption rate of the device among professionals, and we are filtering for devices with a PAR exceeding 8.5.

WITH cte AS (
  SELECT 
    t1.devregistry, 
    t1.profcount, 
    (t1.dpires / 1000.0) * (1 - t1.mcresptime / 10.0) * 10 AS spi, 
    (
      (t2.cgpi / 10.0) * (1 + t1.profcount / 5.0) * (
        (spi + t2.irs) / 15.0
      )
    ) AS par
  FROM 
    deviceidentity AS t1
    JOIN interactionandcontrol AS t2 ON t1.devregistry = t2.interactdevref
)
SELECT 
  devregistry AS "Device Registry ID", 
  cgpi AS "Competitive Gaming Performance", 
  profcount AS "Profile Count", 
  spi AS "Sensor Performance", 
  irs AS "Input Responsiveness Score", 
  par AS "Calculated Adoption Rate Value"
FROM 
  cte
WHERE 
  par > 8.5;
